plan.title: Measure status on an isolated public project snapshot

criteria.description: Collect and retain 30 valid warm and 30 valid guarded guest input-cold status samples from the pinned public naru snapshot and its actual four passing self-check receipts, with manifest binding and cold transition evidence.
Recompute median, nearest-rank p95 and maximum waited-child RSS from the exact sample sets and document real-project and synthetic performance boundaries.

limitations: Automated tests cover the measurement protocol. Actual guest samples are required for closure. Guest residency does not establish host storage cache state.
